proof:
Source: the first half of step 4 of the parent proof, where a finite density gives μ(B_ρ(ξ)) ≤ ofReal((θ_ξ + 1)ω_nρ^n) for small ρ.

Notation: B_ρ(x) := closedBall x ρ; ω_n := unitBallVolume n = volume(ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1); densityRatio n μ x ρ := μ(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n) ∈ [0,∞]. HasDensity n μ x θ means Tendsto (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ).

1. Since θ ≠ ∞, θ < θ + 1 (ENNReal.lt_add_right). The set {y ∈ [0,∞] : y < θ + 1} is an open neighbourhood of θ (Iio_mem_nhds). So by HasDensity n μ x θ, the set {ρ : densityRatio n μ x ρ < θ + 1} belongs to 𝓝[>] 0. A set belongs to 𝓝[>] 0 iff it contains an interval (0, u) with u > 0 (Mathlib mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset). Hence there is r > 0 with densityRatio n μ x ρ < θ + 1 for every ρ ∈ (0, r).

2. 0 < ω_n < ∞. ω_n is the volume of the nonempty open unit ball. That volume is an additive Haar measure on the proper space ℝ^n, so it is positive on nonempty open sets and finite on balls (Mathlib measure_ball_pos, measure_ball_lt_top). For ρ > 0, ofReal(ρ) ∈ (0, ∞), so ofReal(ρ)^n ∈ (0, ∞); for n = 0 it equals 1. Hence D_ρ := ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n satisfies D_ρ ≠ 0 and D_ρ ≠ ∞ for every ρ > 0.

3. Let ρ ∈ (0, r). By step 1, μ(B_ρ(x))/D_ρ ≤ θ + 1. Since D_ρ ∉ {0, ∞}, this is equivalent to μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ (θ + 1)·D_ρ (ENNReal.div_le_iff).

4. Put θ_R := θ.toReal ≥ 0, w := ω_n.toReal ≥ 0 and C := (θ_R + 1)·w ∈ ℝ.
- θ and ω_n are finite, so θ + 1 = ofReal(θ_R + 1) (ENNReal.ofReal_add, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal, ENNReal.ofReal_one) and ω_n = ofReal(w).
- ρ ≥ 0, so ofReal(ρ)^n = ofReal(ρ^n) (ENNReal.ofReal_pow).
- ofReal(a)·ofReal(b) = ofReal(a·b) whenever a ≥ 0 (ENNReal.ofReal_mul).
Therefore (θ + 1)·D_ρ = ofReal(θ_R + 1)·(ofReal(w)·ofReal(ρ^n)) = ofReal((θ_R + 1)·w·ρ^n) = ofReal(C·ρ^n). Combined with step 3, μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(C·ρ^n) for every ρ ∈ (0, r). This proves the claim with these C and r. ∎
key_steps: θ < θ + 1 and HasDensity give r > 0 with densityRatio n μ x ρ < θ + 1 for all ρ ∈ (0, r) (mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset).
0 < ω_n < ∞ and ofReal(ρ)^n ∈ (0, ∞), so ENNReal.div_le_iff gives μ(B_ρ(x)) ≤ (θ + 1)·ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n.
